packageRules.description: Maintenance branches (v1–v3) only receive security fixes and patch-level npm bumps — keep the released major lines stable.
Major updates always require manual approval via the dependency dashboard — KoliBri pins its major lines deliberately (Angular v19/v20/v21, React 18/19, Stencil 4, ESLint 9, …).
Group GitHub Actions updates and automerge them (replaces the github-actions entries in .github/dependabot.yml).
Group all @types/* packages and automerge low-risk type-definition bumps.
Never bump the Angular toolchain across a major — each adapter folder (v19/v20/v21) is intentionally pinned to its Angular major. A new Angular major means a new adapter folder, not an auto-update.
Group within-major updates of the Angular 19 toolchain (packages/adapters/angular/v19).
Group within-major updates of the Angular 20 toolchain (packages/adapters/angular/v20).
Group within-major updates of the Angular 21 toolchain (packages/adapters/angular/v21).
Never bump React across a major — the react / react-v19 / react-standalone / preact adapters each pin their React major on purpose.
Group the within-major React updates of the React adapters (review manually instead of automerging the framework).
Stencil is hard-pinned: every 4.39+ release breaks the Popover API, tooltips and the visual tests (see docs/UPGRADEABLE_DEPENDENCIES.md). Require manual approval for ALL Stencil updates.
@kern-ux/* (theming) is upgraded by hand together with theming work — surface it on the dashboard but do not open PRs automatically.
typescript-eslint minor/major bumps must stay in sync with the ESLint config — group and require manual approval.
ESLint core and its plugins are mid-migration (9 → 10 is breaking) — group and require manual approval for non-patch updates.
Jest major jumps are breaking (Node/TS baseline changes — see docs/UPGRADEABLE_DEPENDENCIES.md). Group and require manual approval for majors.
TypeScript moves in lock-step with the framework toolchains — coordinate minor/major bumps manually.
Group the Stylelint toolchain into a single PR.
Group the Playwright packages into a single PR.
